item.title: Deputy chancellor for family engagement is stepping down. Will a broader reshuffle follow?
item.description: Deputy Chancellor of Family, Community and Student Empowerment Cristina Meléndez at a Community Education Council election voting party on April 28, 2025.

item.title: Vitti seeks ways to boost certification of special education teachers
item.description: Nikolai Vitti, superintendent of the Detroit Public Schools Community District, is urging state education officials to expand access to special education programs and offer incentives to bring in more people to the profession. Vitti is pictured on the first day of school in August 2025.

item.title: Monarca Academy expands to high school with boost from $2 million grant
item.description: Science, technology, engineering, and math teacher Wycliff Ayonga reviews work with students in his class at Monarca Academy. The school plans to grow into a high school at its location in Northwest Middle School.

item.title: These high school students are the caretakers of one of America’s dark chapters
item.description: Granada High School senior Emersen Hernandez gives a tour of the Amache Museum to Cheraw School students on Oct. 22, 2025. When she's talking to younger children about Japanese American incarceration, she asks them to imagine themselves having to give up their home and toys and live in a strange new place.

item.title: Nominee for NJ education commissioner says she would help school districts, not hinder them
item.description: Lily Laux speaks before the Senate Judiciary Committee on Thursday, Feb. 19, 2026 at the New Jersey Statehouse in Trenton.

item.title: Pritzker’s budget plan calls for education funding increases but fall short of requests
item.description: Gov. JB Pritzker revealed his budget proposal for next fiscal year, which calls for less than hoped for increases in education funding.

item.title: Upper East Side gets 132 pre-K and 3-K seats after delayed opening
item.description: Mayor Zohran Mamdani playing with children at a 3-K and Pre-K child care center in Cypress Hills on Jan. 14, 2026.

item.title: State superintendent says Trump’s Michigan schools investigations are based on false info
item.description: The U.S. Department of Justice is investigating the Detroit Public Schools Community District, Lansing School District, and Godfrey-Lee Public Schools to determine whether parents are able to opt their kids out of instruction that contains "gender ideology." The Michigan Department of Education says state law requires districts to do so.

item.title: Where’s Riverstone? New site of ‘public Christian school’ unclear as old location draws scrutiny
item.description: Riverstone Academy moved from the location pictured above in late January. School leaders won't reveal where it's operating now.

item.title: Tennessee private school teachers without a degree could get emergency teaching permits under new bill
item.description: Some Tennessee private school teachers could get public school emergency teaching permits even if they don't have a bachelor's degree under a new bill advancing in the General Assembly.
